questions.question: A sorted array has 1024 elements. Which search method normally needs O(log n) comparisons?
questions.explanation: Binary search repeatedly halves the candidate interval. It requires sorted input and uses O(log n) comparisons.

questions.question: Which structure uses first-in, first-out removal?
questions.explanation: A queue removes the earliest enqueued item first. A stack normally removes the most recently pushed item.

questions.question: Which Python expression evaluates to 8?
questions.explanation: Python uses ** for exponentiation. The ^ operator performs bitwise XOR on integers.
